name: computed-push-validation-type
$comment: ENH-028 push validation, rule 5 (static-kind): a string-producing expression (concat) declared for a NUMBER field fails the schema push with BAD_REQUEST (validate_computed's statically-known-result-kind check — a `pushError` case: the push is the whole case, no seed/op). Field/Coalesce/Case stay untyped and skip this check; concat/lower/trim/arith/now/casts are statically kinded. Mirrors computed_test.rs (9), second half.
